_comment: --cms=none: strip the CMS/Prepr wiring from the boilerplate's root layout. A TEXT PATCH, not a full-file copy, deliberately: the copy this replaced was frozen at the June boilerplate and silently missed the BaseCategoryProvider and initialLanguage work, so every --cms=none scaffold 500'd on every route and served the wrong language. A patch inherits future layout changes, and if the boilerplate edits one of these snippets the scaffolder fails loudly instead of shipping a stale layout.
